background: Paragon Banking Group is a UK specialist lender, funded by retail savings and lending mainly on buy-to-let mortgages to professional landlords, with development finance, motor finance and SME lending alongside.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, BBB on average, both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 29 Jan 2026. Every ratio is below the median for UK mid-sized banks, with CET1 of 13.5% and leverage of 7.2% on the capital side. Liquidity is the weak spot and has moved the wrong way: LCR of 146% is in the bottom quarter after falling 38 points since 31 Mar 2025, and NSFR has fallen 7 points to 135%. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
